source.name: Nashville SC: 'Nashville Soccer Club Introduces “Reverb” Primary Jersey for 2026 and 2027 Seasons'
source.quote: Renasant, remains the club’s official jersey sponsor with its wordmark proudly displayed across the chest
source.note: The club's kit-launch release for the 'Reverb' primary jersey, worn from the 2026 season opener on 21 February 2026.

source.name: Nashville SC: 'Nashville Soccer Club Introduces “Reverb” Primary Jersey for 2026 and 2027 Seasons'
source.quote: the Hyundai Motor Company returns as the team’s primary sleeve partner

source.name: SportsLogos.Net: 'MLS to Allow Back-of-Jersey Ads Starting After 2026 All-Star Break'
source.quote: All 30 MLS clubs feature the Apple TV+ logo on the left sleeve patch as part of a league-wide deal.

summary: The 'Reverb' kit, the club's gold primary jersey for 2026 and 2027, with a center crest for the first time in club history. Renasant stays on the front; Hyundai returns as the primary sleeve partner; the league-wide Apple TV+ patch is on the left sleeve of every MLS kit.
